data.name: The Illuminati Simulator
data.detailed_description:
VR Compatible

VR mode just released, Extra secret level updated, Steam Deck Compatible.
All this in the last update


About the Game

THE ILLUMINATI SIMULATOR

They control the world.

Governments. Corporations. Media. Wars. Revolutions.

For centuries, a hidden order has shaped the course of human history from the shadows. Most people never notice the symbols. The patterns. The doors that only open for those who know where to look.

But you did.

After years of searching, questioning, and pushing too close to the truth…
they finally answered.

You have been invited.

But joining the order is not a privilege.

It is a trial.

You are a secret agent of an American intelligence agency, there is a secret society infiltrating the greatest nation in the world, Your job is to survive the Initiation , gather all the intelligence , and report back to your controllers back at the agency with covert means.

Your Initiation Begins

You spawn inside a massive Masonic temple during a secret ritual — your own initiation. The lodge towers above you, filled with ancient symbols, hidden passages, and deadly tests designed to prove your worth.

To join the Illuminati, you must ascend the temple.

Floor by floor.
Trial by trial.
Secret by secret.

Each chamber hides new challenges based on esoteric traditions and symbolic architecture inspired by real lodges.

Only those who reach the highest level will be accepted into the order that rules the world.

The rest are forgotten.

What Awaits Inside

  • 8 main playable characters 

  • Explore a Masonic lodge inspired by real architectural designs

  • Survive initiation trial across 3 Scenarios.

    NO SAVE you must complete the game in 1 shot to open all the levels

    • VR COMPATIBLE WITH GAMEPAD

  • Features ritual chambers, secret symbols, and hidden paths

  • Climb the temple, Finish your initiation and earn your place among the Illuminati (If you survive)

The Final Question

Many seek the truth.

Very few survive it.

Will you complete the initiation?

Choose your character, unlock secret scenarios, and prove you are worthy to join the Illuminati and claim world power.
